authority: Almanac is the source of truth for gameplay planning, per user. Supporting pages cannot override it. Unspecified or internally inconsistent details remain explicit.

questions.title: Weather events
questions.answer: Almanac section 06 controls gameplay planning. The reviewed deployed oracle confirms weekly weather multiplied by 2 for a covering Flood and again for a covering Moon, then capped at 2×. Flood lasts 24 hours and Moon 48 hours; their overlap is supported. Above-base emission draws are limited by the available Granary.
questions.remaining: Published sealed-week wording conflicts with setNext: owner or keeper can replace a future scheduled epoch before its 24-hour cutoff, and commitHash is not checked. A discarded public RPC simulation confirmed an already-scheduled epoch could be replaced without changing actual chain state. Keep this conflict visible; future event dates and settings still require fresh reads.

questions.title: Harvest fees and gas
questions.answer: Almanac specifies zero harvest game fee and no token approval. Reviewed claim/claimMany code confirms owner checks, historical settlement and a CROP transfer with no token approval or separate game charge. claimMany loops claims within one transaction; one invalid ownership or pause check reverts the batch.
questions.remaining: Ordinary transaction execution does not establish zero wallet-paid network costs or sponsorship. Public eth_call and eth_estimateGas work, but actual fees and payer need fresh estimates and eventual receipt evidence. Keep zero-gas assumptions explicit.

questions.title: Fertilizer and tarp
questions.answer: Store still plans November supplies: fertilizer adds 25% weight for one week; tarp floors a plot’s multiplier at 1×. Cosmetics are removable and resellable; no earning boost is stated.
questions.remaining: Final supply prices, mechanics, transfer and overlapping effects are not published. Store explicitly calls current prices and supplies provisional. No purchase recommendation can be completed yet.

questions.title: Reveal timing
questions.answer: The Almanac remains the published schedule: mint September 15 at 17:00 UTC, reveal within 72 hours. Deployed revealDeadline() is 1789754400, September 18 at 18:00 UTC. Source allows permissionless reveal after the sellout block delay or after that deadline; minting closes at the deadline or successful reveal.
questions.remaining: The deadline and Almanac wording are distinct evidence, not proof that reveal has happened. At block 57200789, startingIndex was 0 and tiersFinalized was false. Reveal and tier finalization need actual transactions and fresh evidence before rarity-based advice.

questions.title: Weekly drawing
questions.answer: Every planted plot gets one free entry. With all 22 planted, the plan is 22 entries across the two wallets. Draws begin in October; ticket CROP burns and prize spending is constrained by ticket funding.
questions.remaining: Town Hall still says the full rules and ticket window will be published before the first draw. Ticket price, entry denominator and prize value are absent, so paid-entry EV is unavailable.

questions.title: Accrual and Genesis
questions.answer: Deployed source confirms four 365-day years with 380M/190M/95M/95M budgets and Genesis September 21 at 00:00 UTC. Historical weather and year boundaries are settled separately; claiming in good weather cannot increase old rewards. Zero planted weight diverts base emissions to the Granary, so the first planter receives no backlog. Above-base weather draws only the available buffer. Claims pause independently from pending accrual and upgrade pause.
questions.remaining: Rounding is now documented: annual budget divided into an integer per-second wei rate, with further 1e12 accumulator and per-plot floors. Forecasts still require future competition, weather and prices. Plant/upgrade source has no Genesis or reveal gate, while the Almanac publishes planting at season opening; any retained pre-Genesis action block is an application policy, not a verified contract restriction.

questions.title: Team and treasury vesting
questions.answer: Almanac section 11 gives treasury vesting over year one and team vesting after a six-month cliff, then two years linear. Treasury no-selling in year one is a stated policy.
questions.remaining: The same section’s broad team-cannot-sell wording does not follow from a six-month cliff alone. Keep the numeric schedule, flag this internal discrepancy, and do not infer a one-year enforceable lock or a price floor.

questions.title: Manifest and rarity odds
questions.answer: Almanac specifies one cyclic offset and the committed manifest still controls the published allocation. Deployed reveal computes hash modulo 3333, then maps result 0 to 1. Thus offset 0 is unreachable and offset 1 combines two residues under a uniform-hash assumption. Uniform sampling of all 3333 offsets remains a separate hypothetical model; source-aware odds must use the deployed mapping.
questions.remaining: No minted IDs or revealed traits exist for our wallets yet. Hash uniformity is an assumption, not proof. rarityTier defaults to zero until owner assignment and can change until tiersFinalized; compare finalized direct tiers, manifest mapping and effective weight. A tier write does not itself synchronize emission weight.

questions.title: API and client interfaces
questions.answer: Sourcify v2 supplied complete source and ABIs for NFT, CROP, activation, levels, emissions and weather, all reporting exact bytecode matches. Their on-chain runtime hashes also matched independent pinned RPC reads at block 57200789. Ownership, balance, allowance, code/linkage, fee, pause and simulation checks can prepare separate human-approved actions. Plant allowance is to the live activation source; upgrade allowance is to levels.
questions.remaining: We did not locally rerun the compiler or reproduce a full security audit. API responses remain unpinned. SeaDrop mint routing, swaps, final supplies, drawings and vesting contracts are outside this source review. Actual wallet transactions were not submitted. See contract-review.md for weather-commitment and reveal-offset discrepancies.

questions.title: Our portfolio and budget
questions.answer: Both user wallet addresses are now configured and publicly read. Neither owns farm plots yet; the plan remains 22, split 11 each. Each wallet exceeded the USD 100 native-ETH target at the funding observation; refresh the dashboard for current valuation.
questions.remaining: Actual future token IDs, revealed traits, an explicit extra-investment budget, fee reserve and executable CROP quotes remain needed. The USD funding target is not an investment authorization.

source_review.authority: Verified deployment behavior supplements the Almanac; implementation discrepancies are explicitly shown and never silently replace the user-designated gameplay rules.
